---
title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---



```{r}

library(fpp3)

# 1) Bricks from aus_production:

# ?aus_production

aus_production %>%                   # %>% is the same as |>
  autoplot(Bricks) +
  labs(
    title = "Quarterly production of clay bricks in millions of bricks in Australia",
    x ="Quarter",
    y = "Bricks"
  )

# we get a graph and "Warning: Removed 20 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range (`geom_line()`)."

# we can check for these missing values
is.na(aus_production$Bricks)


# 2) Lynx from pelt:
pelt %>%
  autoplot(Lynx) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Canadian Lynx pelts traded from 1845 to 1935",
    x ="Year",
    y = "Number of lynx pelts"
  )

# 3) Closing prices from gafa_stock:

gafa_stock %>%
 autoplot(Close) +
  labs(
    title = "Closing stock prices from 2014-2018 for the GAFA",
    subtitle = "all prices are in $USD",
    x ="Year",
    y = "Closing price"
  )

# 4) Demand from vic_elec:

vic_elec[350:500, ] %>%
  autoplot(Demand/1e3) +
  labs(
    title ="Half-hourly electricity demand for Victoria, Australia",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Ectricity demand in MWh"
  
  )

```
